Captured from the unmodified local Palimia interface in dark mode in an isolated development copy on 2026-10-03. A disposable account and 21 fictional catalog works populate a dedicated temporary PostgreSQL database: 12 tracked works and nine recommendation candidates. The frame shows the summary, filters and first six of 12 library entries. No provider calls, provider artwork or real personal data. Only framework development tooling is excluded from the frame.
assets.rights: Application screenshots requested by Ethan Brosselard on 2026-10-03, continuing his 2026-10-02 publication approval. Original application UI; no third-party artwork or personal data.
